system.description: You may now drive others mad with the sound of your voice. To affect the target you must win a Social Challenge against her. Once affected, the target gains a random Derangement (as determined by the Storyteller) for the remainder of the evening; both characters are aware of what the Derangement is and may act accordingly. This power can only affect one target at a time, unless the Daughter of Cacophony spends a Willpower Trait, each Trait spent allowing an additional victim.
